source.snippet: ActivityWatch is great for single device tracking, but I wish there was a tool for multi-device tracking and also away-from-device tracking (tracking gym, sleep, etc...) that integrated all of the data into one place and made it easily accessible.

problem_statement: Knowledge workers and productivity-focused individuals cannot get a unified time and activity tracking view across multiple devices and offline activities (gym, sleep, meetings), forcing them to stitch together data from several disconnected tools.
target_segment: Productivity-obsessed knowledge workers, freelancers, and solo operators who track personal efficiency and billable time across desktop, mobile, and offline contexts
notes: Single HN comment but the author built a Chrome extension (WebBlock) suggesting genuine builder/buyer persona. ActivityWatch has a large open-source user base; multi-device and offline gap is a known limitation. Freelancers billing by time have direct willingness-to-pay. Adjacent to products like Toggl, RescueTime — differentiation is cross-device + offline unification.
